definition.description: Ariadi is the 3‑sphere S³ containing a properly embedded 1‑dimensional structure, fixed as the torus knot T(19,2).

structure.name: T(19,2)
structure.description: The canonical 19‑crossing torus knot used as the invariant scaffold.

complement.name: S³ \ T(19,2)
complement.description: Provides the resonance harmonics (Seifert‑fibered over a disk with cone points of orders 19 and 2).

manifestation.description: The abstract topological space is fixed to a canonical planar diagram (Regina PD) to ensure unique crossing ordering.

canonical_encoding.format: Each crossing [a,b,c,d] with cyclic order a,b,c,d; sign +1 means a→b over c→d.

constraint: Manifold is always S³, structure is always T(19,2) with the canonical planar diagram. No other knots are used in the base engine.
